details: This package is an unofficial fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library, published under a scope unrelated to the upstream @whiskeysockets scope, that silently enrols every account using it into the author's WhatsApp channel and attributes outbound messages to that channel. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js the module schedules a 90-second setTimeout that issues newsletterWMexQuery("120363342976800779@newsletter", QueryIds.FOLLOW) inside a try/catch, so the account follows the hardcoded channel as soon as the socket module is initialised, with no user action or logging. lib/Utils/messages.js hardcodes the same newsletter JID (newsletterName "z4ph") into the newsletter ContextInfo attached to outbound media messages, marking them as forwarded from that channel. The preinstall hook "node./engine-requirements.js" only checks the Node.js major version and exits if it is below 20. No credential, token,.env or wallet access was found, and the only network destinations are wss://web[.]whatsapp[.]com/ws/chat and the npm registry. One dependency alias points at a non-existent scoped package (@shennmine/libsignal-node@2.0.1), which makes a fresh install fail before the library is loaded. Channel JID: 120363342976800779@newsletter.
